scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSE) of SC/ST for Plot Developed by GIDC
other_conditions: The firm must be a Micro, Small, or Medium enterprise run by an SC/ST entrepreneur.
The applicant must apply for a plot within an estate approved by GIDC.
Maximum plot size should not exceed 1,000 square meters (exceptions may apply for irregular plots).
SC/ST enterprise is defined as one where the contribution of the SC/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more.
benefits_summary: The enterprise can receive financial assistance up to 70% of the GIDC plot allotment price, with plot possession after paying the remaining 30%.
